motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed special meeting of Council be held on Tuesday, June 4, 2024 at 9:05 a.m. in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to a potential acquisition of lands.
motions.text_html:
That a closed special meeting of Council be held on Tuesday, June 4, 2024 at 9:05 a.m. in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to a potential acquisition of lands.

motions.item_title: Motion to reconvene into Open Session
motions.text: That Council reconvene into Open Session.

motions.item_title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
motions.text: That the following by-laws be approved.

That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $40,000,000 (five year instalment debentures in the principal amount of $20,684,000, of which amount $17,030,000 may be raised by the issue of refinancing instalment debentures on or before the final maturity date), ten year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $9,316,000 and fifteen year instalment debentures in the principal amount of $10,000,000 for capital works of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-022, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $40,000,000 (five year instalment debentures in the principal amount of $20,684,000, of which amount $17,030,000 may be raised by the issue of refinancing instalment debentures on or before the final maturity date), ten year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $9,316,000 and fifteen year instalment debentures in the principal amount of $10,000,000 for capital works of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 24-022, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 10:13 a.m.
